In flake.nix, you can define various external sources in the inputs section.

When you reference multiple Flakes, each may depend on a different version of nixpkgs. Check the external projects’ compatibility requirements before sharing a version.
If the external Flake supports your current nixpkgs, you can make a specified input follow the main configuration’s version:
Lock versions: run nix flake lock (which updates flake.lock automatically).
Use an Output: reference the corresponding output by variable name in your code.

Learning to reference external Flakes puts the whole Nix community’s toolkit at your disposal. Desktop environments, editors, and specialized development tools can all be made to work “out of the box.”
